name: aimsun-subpath-validation
description: GeoLibre drop-in plugin: simulated-vs-observed subpath journey time validation, driven by the optional subpath_sim_jt table. Dev tooling is borrowed from ../_shared/node_modules.

geolibre.name: Aimsun subpath journey time validation
geolibre.description: Simulated vs observed subpath journey time: scatter with identity and OLS lines, per-route table and KPIs (RMSE, bias, R2, % within tolerance). Shows a clear empty state until the package contains subpath_sim_jt.parquet.
